name: CardiovascularPatients
title: Cardiovascular patients
description: Returns each patient with at least one condition whose code is a member of the cardiovascular disease value set. The value set is a dependency exposed under the cardiovascular_codes label as a relation with the columns system, version, code, display and inactive; membership is tested with a semi-join on system and code, which cannot multiply rows. Author: John Grimes.

relatedArtifact.label: conditions
relatedArtifact.display: Condition view with patient_id, system, version and code columns

relatedArtifact.label: cardiovascular_codes
relatedArtifact.display: Cardiovascular disease value set, exposed as a relation

extension.valueString:
SELECT DISTINCT conditions.patient_id
FROM conditions
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM cardiovascular_codes
  WHERE cardiovascular_codes.system = conditions.system
    AND cardiovascular_codes.code = conditions.code
)
ORDER BY conditions.patient_id
